notes: Window: the Preamble's seven 'Considerando' clauses, the proclamation, and Article 1. FULL propositional coverage per R8: 22 rows, up from 13. Row 0 re-typed SIG·Figure (was CON·Figure) — 'tener por base' is a light-verb copular construction whose predicate noun 'base' is a unique role, copula rule 3's own trigger. Spanish uses two finite subjunctives ('promuevan', 'aseguren') where English has one 'shall strive' with two infinitival complements, so it yields two purpose-adjunct rows where English yields one — a real grammatical difference, recorded rather than normalised.

rows.subject: la libertad, la justicia y la paz en el mundo
rows.object: el reconocimiento de la dignidad intrínseca y de los derechos iguales e inalienables de todos los miembros de la familia humana
rows.because: RE-TYPED 2026-08-31 (was CON·Figure). 'tener por' is a light-verb copular construction, and the predicate noun 'base' is a unique role — copula rule 3's own trigger, the same reading the other four languages get. Spanish states the relation with subject and object swapped relative to English, which changes the argument order, not the act

alternate.because: the prior reading, kept disclosed: 'tienen' read as a full lexical verb asserting a structural grounding relation

rows.anchor: tienen por base el reconocimiento de la dignidad intrínseca

rows.anchor: han originado actos de barbarie ultrajantes para la conciencia de la humanidad

rows.subject: actos de barbarie
rows.object: la conciencia de la humanidad
rows.because: affronting a moral standing — Differentiate·Interpretation, matching English's 'have outraged'. Spanish encodes it as a deverbal ADJECTIVE where English uses a finite relative clause: the proposition is the same, the syntax is not, and `clause` is what records that
rows.resolution: the participial adjective agrees with 'actos de barbarie', the head it modifies

alternate.because: readable as marring an arrangement rather than bounding a meaning

rows.anchor: actos de barbarie ultrajantes para la conciencia de la humanidad
